lines: A certain word pierces you
I tried calling what leaks from the wound "love"
A lack of compassion and sex in form alone
look a lot like you and me, bound by a rotten tie
"Even so, I love you..." and all that
What's wrong with loving, anyway?
Bound so no one can touch it
Isn't this fate too?
Fading, fading, a certain love-world
By the time it ends, I'll be sick of you
What should I call it, letting loose without knowing if it's love or desire?
A lack of compassion and sex in form alone
look a lot like you and me, bound by a rotten tie
Even that would be fine...
And you call that loving?
Clinging on and thrashing about—
what's wrong with killing that, anyway?
The me you hate—
what's wrong with loving, anyway?
Bound so no one can touch it
Isn't this fate too?
Fading, fading, a certain love-world
